payout_quote: bag 20,000 bonus points (a $200 value) when you spend $2,000 within 90 days of account opening.
steps: Confirm you are eligible for Navy Federal Credit Union membership (military community: active duty, veterans, DoD, eligible family).
Read the official More Rewards offer terms on navyfederal.org.
Apply for the More Rewards American Express card between 7/1/2026 and 1/3/2027; a hard credit inquiry is part of the application.
Make $2,000 or more in eligible purchases within 90 days of account opening — only spending you already planned.
Pay in full each month; collect the 20,000 points (a $200 value) once posted.
catches: Never spend extra solely to earn the bonus — only the $2,000 of purchases you were already going to make counts.
No annual fee ($0), so the $200 value is yours to keep net if you meet the spend on planned purchases.
Applying triggers a hard inquiry on your credit report, which can temporarily lower your score.
Carried-balance interest erases the bonus: the variable APR is 14.15%-18.00% — always pay in full.

Military community only: you must be eligible for Navy Federal membership (service members, veterans, DoD civilians, eligible family); the offer expires January 3, 2027, and the 20,000 points can take up to 8 weeks after the 90-day period to post.
biggest_catch: Navy Federal membership is limited to the military community — most people cannot get this card at all; and the $2,000 must be eligible purchases (no gift cards, cash advances, or balance transfers count), with points posting up to 8 weeks after the 90-day window.
eligibility: Navy Federal Credit Union membership (military/veterans/DoD/family); new More Rewards accounts applied for 7/1/2026-1/3/2027; $2,000 in eligible purchases within 90 days; limit one promotional offer per account opening.
timing: Points post up to 8 weeks after the 90-day qualification period; offer expires January 3, 2027.
